INNER HEAD. [3] [Lac. d.]
Throbbing frontal headache, nausea, vomiting and obstinate constipation ; especially in anemic women.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Lac. d.]
General sore pain of head produced by coughing.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Lac. d.]
Great photophobia, even candle light unbearable.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Lac. d.]
Dyspepsia.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Lac. d.]
Constipation : with chronic headache ; most powerful purgatives were of no avail ; feces dry and hard ; diarrhœa ; stool large and hard, passed with great straining, lacerating anus, extorting cries and passing considerable blood ; chronic.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Lac. d.]
Albuminuria.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Lac. d.]
Dropsy : from organic heart disease ; from chronic liver complaint ; far advanced Bright's disease ; following intermittent fever.
